_description: Battle simulator v1 (tools/nn/sim, docs/en/training/simulator.md): the numbers that are neither in a unit passport (config/nn/units.json) nor in the game's rules (config/nn/game_rules.json). Each is measured in the game or calibrated to a measurement (docs/en/training/measurements.md); `why` says which. Written by hand; python -m tools.nn.sim.check compares the simulator with the game.

step_s.why: morale rises 2 points a second before contact in every recording (+0.057 MoralePercent/s at leadership 35 ... +0.029 at 70) = one point (minimium_increment_update_per_tick) per 0.5 s tick

battle_limit_s.why: network plan: 60 minutes, the attacker loses on time

map_half_m.why: measured: routing units leave the map at |x| or |z| = 1020 m (Crossroads flat, 28 runs)

formation.why: arena spearmen: 120 men, width 30 m, rank_depth 6 -> 20 files 1.5 m apart; ranks the same. Centre distance at first contact in the pairs (7.5-12.8 m) matches the depths this gives

contact.why: reach: pairs touch when the formations' edges meet (centre distance 10.6-12.8 m for spearmen against slaves, depths 9 and 13.5 m). lord_max_attackers / lord_direction / lord_rival_others / lord_incidental: the lord swarm probe (01.10.2026, docs/en/game/units/lord-swarm.md; 3 battles, a lord standing, attacked by 1-4 infantry units from front, back and flanks, 5 repeats a layout, lords held by script so no abilities): the lord loses the same whatever the number of units (General 7.8 / 8.3 / 8.7 / 7.4 HP/s with 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 clanrat units, Warlord 6.2 / 5.8 / 5.1 / 4.8 with Empire spearmen); 4-5 enemy soldiers stand within 2.5 m of him, 7-10 within 3 m, shared by the units; an armour-piercing unit counts by its share (General: halberds alone 21.5, with one spear unit 16.1, with three 10.7). So the men striking a lord are capped in all (9 fits the probe's single units and the pairs) and summed, split between the units by their contact; from his back or flank they hit him as from the front (lord_direction 0: the share of the database's flank/rear rule against a lone man). lord_rival_others: with the enemy lord on him too, the infantry's rate counts at this share (whole battles, a lord in melee not shot at: the enemy lord alone 14.5 HP/s, with 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 units targeting him too 18.6 / 10.6 / 15.1 / 20.4; the probe's lord-and-units trials, noisy: 0.7 +- 0.5). lord_incidental: a unit whose attack order is on another enemy strikes a lord it only touches at this share (whole battles: one enemy unit in contact, its current target another: 1.7 HP/s; him: 4.1). Front = within 60 deg of the facing (shield_defence_angle_melee 60), rear = beyond 120 deg. melee_turn_deg_s: a formation in melee turns no faster (a lord at once): measured in the 28 whole battles, infantry in melee standing turns 1 deg/s (median, mean 2.3; 20.8k seconds), a free unit struck in the flank turns 8 deg in the next 5 s (median, 653 contacts). step_m: a unit whose point is nearer does not turn to walk there (formations step back or aside facing the enemy); without it, units replayed to their recorded points stood with their backs to the enemy at contact in the pairs; missile_leave_m: a missile unit in melee told to move this far or farther leaves the fight like a withdraw (0: off). Measured 02.10.2026 (build/simacc/missile_break.py, 28 game-AI and 63 network battles): the game's missile units in melee without a target and with their order point 10 m or more away were moving 45-78 % of those seconds and left melee after 10-12 s (median), against 19-36 s and 2-18 % moving for those holding near their point; the simulator keeps missile units in melee 284 s a battle against the game's 162 (median spell 15 s against 8). At 10 m (and the replay moving such units instead of fighting the nearest enemy) the check got no better (same winner 19 of 26 and 37 of 63 with the two lord numbers below; 20 / 36 without it), so it stays off. Task 20 (02.10.2026): on at 10 m together with lord_v_lord 0.73, lord_fall 0 and the database set (sim.json morale why): each alone lowered the winners because the errors compensated each other; together with the rest the winners hold (game-AI 18 of 26, network 43 of 71 against 20 / 43 with all off) and more battles end as in the game. lord_v_lord: a lord striking a lord hits at this share of the rule (1: off). Measured 02.10.2026 (build/simacc/lordduel.py): HP/s of a lord in melee whose only enemy on him is the other lord, not shot at, in the 28 game-AI and 63 network battles: the General 14.6 (2.5k s), the Warlord 10.0 (1.6k s) in the game, 19.4 / 15.0 in the simulator: 0.73. Infantry on a lord is too strong in those battles as well (one unit on him: game 3.3 / 2.9, simulator 4.7 / 4.1) while the lord swarm probe and the pairs match. At 0.73 the network battles got worse (same winner 36 of 63 against 40; mean |side-balance error| 0.176 against 0.165): something else compensates, so it stays off until the battle-level lord loss is understood. On since task 20 (see missile_leave_m). Still: the simulator's lords fall too soon in whole battles (network battles: median 130-145 s earlier than the game; at 4 % health against the game's 16 %; in melee 53 % of their time against 45 %) - the game's lords break off melee (0.030 a second) and shatter with health left, which the simulator does not have unit_incidental: a unit whose attack order is on another enemy strikes an enemy unit it only touches at this share of its rate (the gate battles of 02.10.2026, 10 battles with Skaven replayed open-loop: an infantry unit fought by one enemy unit while other enemy units stood within 35 m of it took 19.6 HP/s in the game, 33.9 in the simulator without the rule, 22.3 with 0.3; with no other enemy near 16.5 / 20.7; the check's battles: same winner 22 of 26 against 18, the pairs unchanged, 51 of 54).

melee.why: splash_divides: a splash blow's damage is divided among the men it strikes (CA forum, the community; docs/en/game/mechanics/melee.md#splash), then each share is capped at a man's health: no change for the lords against today's infantry (a share is still above a man's 48-76 HP), it matters for heavier targets. The rest: calibrated on the four melee pairs (tools/nn/sim/check.py). The hit_slope 0.1 is kept against the database's 1 (CA confirmed the formula, task 20): the pairs show the same losses whatever attack - defence is, so something else (matched combat, blow cycle) flattens it in practice. The database rule hit = 35 + attack - defence does not fit: the losses of all four pairs and both lords need about the same 30-38 % whatever attack - defence is (from -35 to +31); hit_slope scales attack - defence (1 = the database rule). fighting_files: men striking = this share of the files in contact (0.75 x 20 = 15 of a 30 m front). impact: extra damage of a charging unit in the first 13 s (charge_decay_duration), times the charge factor; fitted to the HP lost in the first 15 s of the pairs, then lowered from 2.5 to 1.5 on the 28 whole battles (01.10.2026): there a unit charged while standing lost 0.82 of what its charger lost in the first 15 s (102 contacts), the simulator at 2.5 gave 2.7; at 1.5 the pairs stay 51 of 54 within 20 %. flank_slope / rear_slope: defence lost to a flank / rear attack counts at this weight of the rule (1 = the database rule; a lone man always 1): fitted so that infantry fought on the flank loses 1.74x (1.56-1.89 over runs) and on the rear 1.31x (1.19-1.42) what it loses from the front in the whole battles (5.5k / 2.1k seconds; sector by the angle of the enemy's centre, as the simulator counts it); the simulator gives 1.55 / 1.50. braced_speed: a unit with charge_reflection slower than this (m/s) at contact is braced and meets a frontal infantry charge as a charge (measured: braced spearmen charged head-on lose 0.80 of what the charger loses, 87 contacts; the database's charge_reflect_min_charge_factor_threshold 0.7 is not applied, chargers here meet their target at 0.55-0.9 of their run)

kills.why: men lost per HP lost: blows that do not kill wound; men share = max(1 - g (1 - hp share), hp share), g = (hits to kill)^-exponent; fitted to men against health in the pairs (at half health: slaves 0.6 of men, spearmen 0.7-0.78; lords kill whole men: 1)

missile.musket_why: ESTIMATE, not measured (02.10.2026): Free Company Militia pistols (category musket, trajectory low = direct fire, range 90 m, passport reload 9 s -> 10.8 s by reload_scale_other, aim_s_other). The projectile's calibration area is 2.0 m at 65 m against the arrow's 3.7 m at 95 m: at the edge of range the pistol spreads 2.0 x 90 / 65 = 2.8 m, the arrow 3.7 x 125 / 95 = 4.9 m; a flat shot also carries on through the ranks (penetration low: up to 2 men). 0.5 x the distance factor at 60-90 m (1.12-1.29) gives 0.56-0.65 hits per shot, between the arrow's 0.42 and 1 / spread scaling (0.74). To measure: docs/en/training/units.md, recordings wanted.
missile.why: measured (measurements.md, shooting at a unit that stands): reload in practice 11.0 s arrows (passport 10) and 11.5 s sling (passport 9); hit rate at the edge of range 0.42 and 0.47; first shot 3.3 and 4.3 s after halting. Other projectiles: the mean, reload x1.2 of the passport. distance_factor: HP per arrow against the distance, relative to 105-130 m, from the range test (28.09.2026, standing spearmen: c = 13.4 at 70 m, 11.6 at 90 m, 9.5-10.4 at 105-120 m), held below 70 m; the arena's 34 m (~25 HP) and 52 m (~18 HP) are left out: they exceed or reach the arrow's whole damage (19), so melee losses are mixed in. single_entity_factor: HP a lord loses per projectile aimed at him while he is out of melee for the whole flight (the shot's second and the 2 s after), against the unit rule with his armour, shield (by the shooter's side), resistance and distance factor: 0.43 over ~33k shots of the 18 mirror and 10 Empire-Skaven battles (General by arrows ~0.5, by sling ~0.37, Warlord by arrows ~0.32; per battle median 0.43). An earlier count gave 0.9: its 2-second loss windows overlapped and counted each loss twice. friendly_fire: of the hits aimed at a unit in melee, the share that lands on the shooter's own units in contact with it. Measured in the recordings: in the seconds a missile unit shoots an enemy that fights its own units (and nobody shoots those units), their HP lost beyond the melee rule (and beyond the 1.15x / 1.5x they lose when their own side does not shoot), against those shots' hits by the unit rule: arrows 0.26 (18 mirror battles, 1.5k seconds), sling 0.56 (10 Empire-Skaven battles, 1.3k seconds); other projectiles: the mean; a lord among those units takes his share x single_entity_factor (a lone target; 01.10.2026, otherwise a lord in melee with shot enemies took the whole friendly fire). spill: of the hits aimed at a unit, the share that lands on each other unit of the target's side out of melee, by the distance between their centres: in the recordings a unit nobody shoots at, out of melee, with an enemy-shot neighbour within 30 m loses 0.115 of the hits that neighbour takes by the unit rule (2.1k seconds), 0.034 at 30-60 m (6.3k), 0.015 at 60-90 m (7.2k), 0.005 beyond (units with no shot neighbour lose 0.7 HP/s); spill_melee: the same for the target's own units that are in melee too, when the target is in melee (01.10.2026, build/nn-sim/flank/spill_melee.py: HP a unit in melee, not shot at itself and whose own side does not shoot its opponents, loses regressed on its melee rule and on the hits aimed at other units of its side in melee, by centre distance: 0.19 within 15 m, 0.047 at 15-30 m, 0.035 at 30-60 m (the 27 net runs and the 28 game-AI battles, 74k seconds, 15k with a shot neighbour; the 28 battles alone 0.23 / 0.09 / 0.16, the net runs 0.19 / 0.05 / 0.035, the far bin taken from the net runs). Before it, only units out of melee took spill, so units fighting around a lord the enemy shoots at (run 20261001-074420) lost nothing to those shots; it is why an infantry unit in a whole battle loses ~1.3x per shot aimed at it what the lone target of the shooting arena does. Without it a unit in melee loses 3.2x the melee rule (Skaven infantry) and 2.2x (Empire infantry, mirror) while its own missile units shoot at the enemy it fights, 1.5x and 1.15x otherwise

morale.why: Task 20 (02.10.2026, build/simacc/kb_eval.py, kb_events.py, collapse.py; docs/en/game/mechanics/README.md conflicts): casualties_s: the window of recent casualties (the database's description, WH2: the last 4 s; extended casualties -4...-60 over the last 60 s, extended_s). Taken literally (4 s + 60 s) the archers' target wavers 90 % late (73 s against 39 s) and the slingers' target never wavers; 10 s: +54 %; 30 s with the 60 s extended casualties on top: the pairs waver too early (47 of 54). Only the single 30 s window keeps 51 of 54, so it stays (extended_s 0: off) - the game's recent casualties are probably counted otherwise (to record: CCO PercentCasualtiesRecently / PercentHpLostRecently). attacked_event: the database's was_attacked_in_flank / _rear -6 / -14 for the 0.5 s tick a unit is first struck from a worse side (battle.py), instead of the regressed -1 / -2 while struck: in the 91 recordings a unit first struck in the flank drops 1.5 points more over 1-2 s than one first struck in front (309 / 1457 contacts), in the rear 1.9 more (202) - one tick of -6 / -14 (1 and 2.1 points); a new attacker on a unit already fighting: 0.4-0.9 more. aura_fade: the lord's +4 fades from 70 m to 0 at 105 m (inspiration_radius_max_effect_range_modifier 1.5). collapse: the database's army destruction (ume_concerned_army_destruction -120 when the enemy's strength >= army_destruction_enemy_strength_ratio 2.6 x own and own <= army_destruction_alliance_strength_ratio 0.22 of the start); strength = multiplayer cost x health share (hp_power) of the units counted: alive = not shattered, routing included (the game's 91 battles: the trigger fires at a collapse in 32 of 36 sides, median 2 s before it, but 36 collapses have no trigger), standing (79 triggers, 63 with a collapse, but 50 s early). The game's balance of power is not recorded yet (to record: CCO BattleRoot BalanceOfPowerPercent, unit:strategic_value()). Not modelled, checked: charge morale (the database's charge_bonus +15 / charge_timeout 60): a unit that runs into contact (3343 contacts) loses as much morale over the next 1-4 s as one met standing (1500), no +15 shows. lord_fall: points the rest of the army loses when its lord falls (dead or shattered), for recent_s, then lasting (on top of losing his aura). 0 / 0 since task 20 (the database's ume_concerned_general_died_recently -16 / _dead -10 before; the measurement below shows only the aura). Measured 02.10.2026 (build/simacc/lordfall2.py): in all 75 recorded lord falls the lord shattered with 2-50 % of his health left (none was killed), and the standing units of his army (167 unit-falls, 35 falls) changed by 0 points in the 10 s before, -1 at the fall, -3.2 / -4.3 / -4.7 / -4.8 (mean; median -3) 2 / 4 / 6 / 10 s after, -7 at 20 s - about the aura; the simulator gives -9 / -14 / -17 / -18 and routs 39 % of the army within 10 s of a fall (the game 21 %). With 0 / 0 the winners did not change (20 of 26, 36 of 63 with lord_v_lord) but more simulated battles stayed undecided at the recording's end (76 % against 66 %): the game's armies do collapse at the end, all at once (68 of 182 sides: 60 % of the standing units drop 0.4 MoralePercent within 3 s), by a rule not tied to the lord (the database's army destruction -120 at enemy / own strength 2.6 and own 22 % of the start does not time these collapses with strength = cost x health: 8-11 of 58 within 5 s). Until that rule is modelled the -16 / -10 stand in for it. faction_bonus: before contact Skaven units stand 6 points higher than the Empire's in the same place (slaves, clanrats, slingers; pairs, shooting, whole battles). recent_s / recent_of_current: the window of 'recent casualties' (the database gives the penalties, not the window) and whether its share is of the health left; calibrated on the waver and rout times of the pairs and the shooting. combat_ratio: melee HP dealt / taken for winning slightly, winning, significantly (the database gives only the points). rally_mp: a routing unit rallies at MoralePercent ~0.23 (morale.md, median 0.22 at 365 rallies). rally_free_m: no standing enemy that near (at 365 rallies of the mirror and Empire-Skaven battles the nearest standing enemy was 91 m or more in 90 %). rally_rate: points a second a routing unit regains while free, calibrated to the rallies of the whole battles (median 44 s). rout_floor_mp: where morale stands at most when the rout begins (recorded MoralePercent at the rout: median -0.03, 10 % below -0.17). rout_speed: a routing unit runs at this share of its run speed (median of the recorded routing speed: Empire units 0.80-0.86, Skaven 0.85-0.96). attacked_flank / attacked_rear: points while an enemy strikes from the flank / rear, instead of the database's was_attacked_in_flank -6 / _rear -14: regressing morale points - leadership of infantry in melee in the 28 whole battles (30k seconds; on health lost, flank, rear, contacts, the lf/rf/bf flags, under fire) gives -1.0 / -1.8, while the same regression on the simulator with the database's points gives -1 / -14.5. The same regression gives -3.9 / -8.1 for one / several of lf, rf, bf: the database's ume_concerned_flanks_exposed_single / _multiple -3 / -6, used as they are

fatigue.why: effects: the database's unit_fatigue_effects_tables (21 rows, read from db.pack 02.10.2026 by build/simacc/fat_db.py; level, stat, multiplier; missing x1): fatigue.py effects() scales speed, melee attack and defence, armour, charge bonus, AP damage and reload (time / stat_reloading). per_second: the database gives points per activity but not the time (a forum claim: a 0.1 s tick, 10x a second, not taken); regressing the recorded fatigue states (18 mirror battles, 1315 transitions) gives 5.0x a second for melee, 4.8x for shooting, 6.2x for running

threat.why: lf / rf / bf: a non-routing enemy within this distance in the left, right or rear sector; not calibrated

abilities.why: Lord abilities (tools/nn/sim/abilities.py). The numbers (active and recharge time, range, targets, effects) are the ability passports, config/nn/abilities.json (py -3.14 -m tools.nn.abilities, the game's database); what each unit owns: units.json abilities (the slots: tools/nn/sim/abilities.py slot_keys). model: the abilities whose effects the simulator lays on (the lords' actives and Hold the Line); the conditional passives (Single Entity, Scurry Away, Strength in Numbers: when they are on is in tables not decoded) are shown to the network but have no effect here. Effects modelled: scalar_speed (walk, run, and the charge speed unless scalar_charge_speed is given), scalar_charge_speed, melee attack and defence (add), melee damage base and AP (mult), charge bonus (mult), stat_morale (add, morale points). Verminous Valour's 25 m, 1 s blast (battle_vortexs) has damage 0 and AP 0 (hand decode): not modelled. triggers: when the game's AI fires an active (an assumption, not measured): melee = its lord is in melee, near = a standing enemy within near_m of him (the recordings show the Warlord running 5-6.5 m/s, above his run 4.0 and charge 4.7, when closing in), waver = a friend within range_m wavers or routs; default_trigger for an active not listed. The network fires its lord's self-cast actives by order (Orders.ability). Ready again recharge_s after the active time ends; ready at the start (no initial recharge found). Flagellants (02.10.2026): Frenzy (passive: +10 melee attack, x1.1 damage, AP and charge; off while morale is below half of leadership - never for these unbreakable men) and Strength of the Penitent (a timed passive the game fires itself: in melee and losing it, 20 s of +14 melee defence and +15 % physical resistance, off out of melee, 3 s recharge) are modelled; their trigger and switch-off come from the database (passport auto_when / off_when, tools/nn/sim/abilities.py), 'losing' = the morale rule's combat ratio 1.5. Scurry Away and Strength in Numbers now have their conditions too (off_when) but stay out of `model` until checked against the Skaven recordings.
